params.description: Quoted positive decimal current role revision, for example "3".

params.name: X-Step-Up-Proof
params.description: Opaque 32-byte base64url MFA proof. Required when the affected permission set contains a catalog entry with step_up_required=true. The server consumes it in the RBAC transaction and binds the use to the operation, authenticated tenant actor and session, target role, subject or grant, expected revision, normalized business payload, and idempotency key. Reusing the proof for a different logical mutation is rejected even when request IDs match.
